meaning: A local output receipt binds one registered reconciled project plan and qualified artifact view to exact generated source bytes without claiming native execution or formal assurance.
selection_file: An explicit absolute normalized regular JSON file is size-bounded, read once without following symbolic links, and decoded as authored reconciled selection data. Missing, malformed or unsupported data rejects before creating output.
commands: The existing instantiate, instantiate-project, build and verify commands accept a valued --compilation-selection path. Without this option their legacy paths remain unchanged. Language and optional numeric profile must agree with the selection; unsupported layouts, integration profiles and verification commands reject explicitly without fallback.
publication: Only a registered checked project plan can publish its exact artifact view. Preexisting targets, including dangling links, reject. Private sibling staging, exclusive file creation, receipt creation and rename form one local publication attempt. Failed attempts remove only their own staging directory. Native file safety and concurrent-writer qualification remain independently testable obligations.
receipt: Record the exact project, shared artifact plan, selected roots, artifact view, compiler-definition/capsule identities and artifact hashes. The canonical receipt bytes are independent of the target directory. Never reuse a legacy receipt whose meaning includes different evidence.
verification: Read-only verification compares exact receipt bytes, planned artifact bytes and complete path inventory, rejects links and nonregular entries, and reports artifact-currentness only. Native compilation, semantic observation and formal verification are explicitly not performed by this operation.
